title: Single Number
kidExplanation: Story version: To find the single number in an array where all other numbers appear twice, we can use the XOR operation. XORing a number with itself results in 0, and XORing any number with 0 results in the number itself. Therefore, if we XOR all the numbers in the array, the duplicates will cancel out, leaving only the single number. (We will slow down and draw it.)
